core_obligations: Show f^*beta = [X/X/Y]_e cap beta in Z_{e + r}(X) for f flat of relative dimension e (proof lines 2454-2466). The equality is local on X, so assume Y affine; beta is then a finite integer linear combination of prime cycles, and both sides are additive in beta, so reduce to beta = [W] with W integral closed of delta-dimension r (proof lines 2455-2459). Let f^{-1}(W) = W x_Y X be the scheme theoretic inverse image; by lemma-action-closed (tag 0H6A) [X/X/Y]_e cap beta = [W x_Y X]_{r + e}, and by chow-definition-flat-pullback (tag 02RB) f^*beta = [f^{-1}(W)]_{r + e}; the two agree (proof lines 2459-2465).
proof_roadmap: Localize on X so Y is affine, and reduce to prime cycles by additivity of both sides (proof lines 2455-2459).
Compute the action on [W] via the action-closed lemma and flat pullback via the Chow Homology definition; the results agree (proof lines 2459-2465).
